🎟️ TOUR NEWS: The Rasmus announce 23-date European tour for 2027

The Finnish band The Rasmus have announced 23 European shows for early 2027, opening in Tallinn, Riga and Vilnius at the end of January. Five German club dates run from Mannheim on 14 February to Erlangen on 22 February, and the tour closes with eight shows in England in early March.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Dead Pioneers announce seven German shows for April 2027

Dead Pioneers have announced a German club tour for April 2027. Seven shows are listed between 1 and 9 April, in Cologne, Berlin, Hamburg, Münster, Munich, Schweinfurt and Saarbrücken.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Spanish Love Songs confirm 2027 UK and European tour

Spanish Love Songs have confirmed a UK and European tour for January and February 2027, tied to their fifth album Future Nausea, released on 6 November 2026 via Pure Noise Records. Five German shows start in Cologne on 28 January, and the route also takes in Vienna, London and two Spanish cities.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Hawthorne Heights and Senses Fail join Rock am Ring 2027

Hawthorne Heights and Senses Fail have been added to the 2027 lineup of Rock am Ring and Rock im Park. The two linked festivals take place from 4 to 6 June 2027 at the Nürburgring and in Nuremberg, Germany.
